# DiG Shine

> DiG Shine is a digital growth agency founded in 2026 by Karan Verma (CEO & Founder) and Manoj (Co-Founder). The agency provides AI services, business workflow automation, digital marketing, performance marketing, and SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

Canonical website: https://digshine.in

## Services

- [Services overview](https://digshine.in/services): Overview of DiG Shine's services.
- [AI services and agents](https://digshine.in/services/ai-services): AI assistants, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation systems.
- [Automation and workflows](https://digshine.in/services/automation-workflow): CRM and business-process workflow automation.
- [Brand growth and positioning](https://digshine.in/services/brand-growth): Brand identity, market positioning, and messaging.
- [Brand success and analytics](https://digshine.in/services/brand-success): Retention, customer lifetime value, and analytics.
- [Digital marketing](https://digshine.in/services/digital-marketing): Full-funnel digital marketing services.
- [Performance marketing](https://digshine.in/services/performance-marketing): Paid acquisition and performance marketing.
- [Paid advertising](https://digshine.in/services/paid-advertising): Paid advertising across search, social, and video channels.
- [SEO, AEO, and GEO](https://digshine.in/services/seo-aeo-geo): Search visibility and generative-answer optimization.
